nameOrigin: floating marker in the sea (usually orange)
small mammal with a long body

pokedexEntries.di: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

pokedexEntries.prl: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

pokedexEntries.pt: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

pokedexEntries.bw: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.

pokedexEntries.x: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

pokedexEntries.bd: When air fills the flotation sac on its neck, the sac balloons like an inner tube. This Pokémon floats with its head out of the water.

pokedexEntries.shp: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

pokedexEntries.la: It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.
